camel_example: aliyun edas POST /pop/v1/eam/scale/application_scaling_rule --region cn-hangzhou --ScalingRuleMetric 1 --ScalingRuleTimer 1 --ScalingRuleTrigger 'ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_......' --ScalingRuleName 'cpu-trigger' --AppId '78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000' --ScalingRuleEnable true --ScalingBehaviour '{"scaleUp":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":"0","selectPolicy":"Max","policies":[{"type":"Pods","value":5,"periodSeconds":15}]},"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":"300","selectPolicy":"Max","policies":[{"type":"Percent","value":200,"periodSeconds":15}]}}' --ScalingRuleType trigger --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Call the CreateApplicationScalingRule operation to create an Auto Scaling rule for an application
description_zh: 调用CreateApplicationScalingRule接口创建应用的弹性伸缩规则
kebab_example: aliyun edas create-application-scaling-rule --app-id 78194c76-3dca-418e-a263-cccd1ab40000 --scaling-rule-name cpu-trigger --scaling-rule-type trigger --scaling-rule-enable true --scaling-rule-metric 1 --scaling-rule-timer 1 --scaling-rule-trigger ScalingRuleTriggerDTO_...... --scaling-behaviour '{"scaleUp":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":"0","selectPolicy":"Max","policies":[{"type":"Pods","value":5,"periodSeconds":15}]},"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":"300","selectPolicy":"Max","policies":[{"type":"Percent","value":200,"periodSeconds":15}]}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplicationScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The application ID. To get this ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/149390.html operation
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Auto Scaling rule. The name must start with a lowercase letter. It can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 32 characters long
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩策略的名称。支持以小写字母开头，允许小写字母、数字、中划线（-）组成，长度为1~32字符的字符串
parameters.name: scaling_rule_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the Auto Scaling rule. Only the trigger type is supported
parameters.help_zh: 弹性伸缩策略类型，仅支持trigger类型
parameters.name: scaling_rule_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the Auto Scaling rule.

true: enables the rule.

false: disables the rule
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用弹性伸缩策略。

true：启用规则。

false：禁用规则
parameters.name: scaling_rule_enable

parameters.help_en: The trigger policy. Set this parameter to a JSON string of the ScalingRuleTriggerDTO object. For more information about the format, see Additional information about request parameters
parameters.help_zh: 触发器策略。设置为ScalingRuleTriggerDTO的JSON格式，具体样式，请参见请求参数补充说明
parameters.name: scaling_rule_trigger

parameters.help_en: The configuration for custom scaling behaviors. For more information about the data structure, see the example
parameters.help_zh: 配置自定义弹性行为，具体数据结构参考样例
parameters.name: scaling_behaviour
